name: Rissai Valley, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
positioning: Mountain villa resort near the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
best_for: Travelers who want a villa base near Jiuzhaigou with Tibetan-inspired design
Guests who enjoy nature outings, spa time and local Sichuan cuisine

facts.text: The resort is close to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Jiuzhaigou.
The villas have sweeping views of the Minshan mountains and a design drawing from Tibetan culture.
La Montagne is a specialty restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine with local ingredients.
Bo Ri Village serves local comfort food, with Sichuan noodles and family hot pot among its specialties.
Rissai Spa has a heated indoor pool with a panoramic mountain view.
The fitness center is open 24 hours and has Technogym cardio machines.
Guests can go hiking, biking or stargazing in the surrounding Jiuzhaigou nature reserve.
Tibetan journeys in the surrounding villages include home visits and incense workshops.
Children's activities include arts and crafts, treasure hunts, kite-flying and organic farming.
The resort offers limousine transportation to and from Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport.

highlights.text: The building was designed by WATG, with interiors by the late Jaya Ibrahim.
Each guest is guided by a dedicated Nieba, a personal host who offers local knowledge and connects guests to resort experiences.
Cai Lin Xuan serves traditional Sichuan, Tibetan and Cantonese cuisines.
The spa's Eaglewood Vibration Ritual combines Tibetan singing bowls with agarwood oil.
Bathroom amenities were created in collaboration with Frédéric Malle.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountainous location requires significant travel planning.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the Reserve-level positioning.
